title: Words and numbers: a dynamical systems perspective
summary: Along with some known and less known results, we discuss new insights relating combinatorics of words and the ordering of the rationals from a dynamical systems point of view, somehow continuing along the path started in [BI]. We obtain in particular a set of results that structure and enrich the correspondence between the Stern-Brocot (SB) ordering of rational numbers and the corresponding ordering of Farey-Christoffel (FC) words, a class of words that, since their appearance in literature at the end of the 18th century, have revealed numerous relationships with other fields of mathematics.…
